inputs.text: These workers from the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are protesting outside the Presidential Palace and demanding a 24-hour strike to lock in ironclad, legally binding job security. The government has already met their most significant demands, yet they refuse to accept responsibility and are disrupting the order that keeps our education system running for families. Such actions reveal a troubling sense of entitlement that threatens the authority and stability our traditions depend on, rather than any focus on personal accountability that would better serve the nation.
